_what: Europe PMC records for the gene-set-testing prior art the transcriptional-output manuscript positions itself against, retrieved 2026-08-10 so that no identifier in that manuscript's reference list is written from recollection.
_why: Simulated peer review of nr4a3-fusion-transcriptional-output.md found that the paper cited no statistical prior art at all while presenting a competitive gene-set null as its own contribution. Adding those citations from memory is the exact failure research/manuscripts/lint_citations.py exists to catch, so they were fetched instead.
_how: GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/fetch-literature.yml, query path (scripts/fetch-paper.mjs sync), which runs the Europe PMC REST search API with resultType=core and writes the record set to the literature-cache branch. Three dispatches, each with a title/author/DOI-keyed query. Every field below is copied from the returned record; nothing is completed from memory.
_scope: A citation index. It carries no result, measures nothing about any disease or agent, and asserts nothing about efficacy, selectivity, safety, a therapeutic window or clinical readiness.

runs.query: (TITLE:"competitive gene set test accounting for inter-gene correlation") OR (TITLE:"rotation gene set tests for complex microarray experiments") OR (TITLE:"gene expression data in terms of gene sets") OR (TITLE:"On testing the significance of sets of genes") OR (TITLE:"Single sample scoring of molecular phenotypes") OR (TITLE:"gene set variation analysis for microarray and RNA-seq data") OR (TITLE:"knowledge-based approach for interpreting genome-wide expression profiles") OR (TITLE:"Permutation P-values should never be zero") OR (TITLE:"Controlling the false discovery rate") OR (TITLE:"oncogenic KRAS-driven cancers require TBK1") OR (TITLE:"multicellular ecosystem of metastatic melanoma") OR (TITLE:"generalization of Student's problem when several different population variances are involved")

(TITLE:"Controlling the false discovery rate: a practical and powerful approach to multiple testing") OR (AUTH:"Benjamini Y" AND AUTH:"Hochberg Y" AND PUB_YEAR:1995) OR (AUTH:"Efron B" AND AUTH:"Tibshirani R" AND PUB_YEAR:2007) OR (TITLE:"significance of sets of genes") OR (TITLE:"generalization of Student") OR (AUTH:"Welch BL" AND PUB_YEAR:1947) OR (TITLE:"restandardization" AND gene) OR (TITLE:"Gene set analysis of genome-wide association studies") OR (TITLE:"Gene set enrichment analysis made simple")

(DOI:"10.1111/j.2517-6161.1995.tb02031.x") OR (DOI:"10.1214/07-AOAS101") OR (TITLE:"practical and powerful approach to multiple testing") OR (AUTH:"Tibshirani" AND TITLE:"sets of genes") OR (TITLE:"Gene set enrichment analysis: performance evaluation") OR (TITLE:"Toward a gold standard for benchmarking gene set enrichment analysis") OR (TITLE:"Ten years of pathway analysis") OR (TITLE:"Enrichment or depletion of a GO category within a class of genes")

_selection_note: The three queries returned 41 records between them; the 13 below are the ones the manuscript cites. The remainder are unrelated papers whose titles matched a broad clause (chiefly 'controlling the false discovery rate' in proteomics, ecology and psychometrics) and are left in the literature-cache corpus rather than copied here.

not_retrieved._what: Two references the manuscript's revised Methods names in prose. Neither journal is indexed by Europe PMC, so no record could be retrieved and NO IDENTIFIER IS WRITTEN FOR EITHER, here or in the manuscript. Both must be completed against the primary source before submission; this entry is the open task.
not_retrieved._why_it_is_recorded_rather_than_guessed: writing a volume, page range or DOI from recollection is the failure mode research/manuscripts/lint_citations.py was built for. An honest gap is cheaper than a fabricated identifier.
